OwnerName: Eclipse Thoroughbred Partners, Sabby Racing & Michael House

RaceName: Del Mar Oaks Presented By Keeneland Sales (Grade 1) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Related to Stakes winner Diamond Wow; split Inbox and Wild Like The West when third in June at Santa Anita in an allowance listed.

RaceName: Del Mar Oaks Presented By Keeneland Sales (Grade 1) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: On target three times in her last five outings; proved competitive when hitting the board in a Grade 2 four months ago; useful performance to win at Churchill Downs by 6l in an allowance listed two months ago; strong contender.

RaceName: Del Mar Oaks Presented By Keeneland Sales (Grade 1) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: On target three times in seven runs overseas, earning decent prize-money; one to watch in the market making debut on these shores.

RaceName: Del Mar Oaks Presented By Keeneland Sales (Grade 1) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Opened account at the fourth time of asking when in front by just under 3l (Ellis Park) last month in a maiden special weight; winless in three starts overseas; despite that Ellis Park success, looks risky.

RaceName: Del Mar Oaks Presented By Keeneland Sales (Grade 1) (Fillies) (Turf)
OwnerName: Hopeless Stables, Little Red Feather Racing Et Al
Spotlight: Good effort when close up over 1m here (handicap Grade 2) with three of these rivals behind her last month; shouldn't be too far away.

RaceName: Del Mar Oaks Presented By Keeneland Sales (Grade 1) (Fillies) (Turf)
OwnerName: Little Red Feather Racing & William Strauss
Spotlight: Successful twice in her last five starts; split a number of these rivals when fourth beaten just over 2l last month in a handicap Grade 2; now tried over a longer trip.

RaceName: Del Mar Oaks Presented By Keeneland Sales (Grade 1) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Finished behind three of these rivals five weeks ago when beaten 5l in a handicap Grade 2; possible blip last time out as had been running well previously; not hard to turn elsewhere as this looks a fair heat.

RaceName: Del Mar Oaks Presented By Keeneland Sales (Grade 1) (Fillies) (Turf)
OwnerName: Agave Racing Stable, Medallion Racing & Evan Trommer
Spotlight: Won the Belmont Oaks by just under 2l at Saratoga last month; has earned plenty of prize money overseas, on target two from nine starts; is respected.

RaceName: Del Mar Oaks Presented By Keeneland Sales (Grade 1) (Fillies) (Turf)
OwnerName: Larry R Rodgers, James J Lamonica Et Al
Spotlight: Split a number of these rivals last month when third (sent off 13-8) in a handicap Grade 2; winner of two of her four career runs; covers an extra 1f here.

RaceName: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: Baker Stables LLC, Scanlan Racing LLC & Michael Golovko
Spotlight: Progressed into very useful filly in 2025, winning five times including Grade 3 Torry Pines Stakes here (1m; by half a length) in August; improved again last two starts, winning Grade 2 Santa Margarita at Santa Anita (9f; easily by 4l) in May before half-length second to Eunomia in Clement L. Hirsch Stakes here (8.5f) this month; tougher task against makes and has to prove stamina.

RaceName: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: C2 Racing Stable LLC, Mathis Stable LLC & TCC Stables LLC
Spotlight: Hard-charging front-runner; got loose early in Grade 2 at Santa Anita in May (1m2f) and proceeded to register very smart effort in winning by nearly 10l from Malarchuk; nowhere near same level in the face of even mild pressure, including last time, and will not find this group accommodating.

RaceName: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Japanese-trained colt by Gun Runner; won Listed Tokyo Derby at Ohi in June (1m2f, muddy) by about a length in 16-runner field (second-fastest time in race history); it's hard to be confident how he fits in terms of class but he is nicely drawn; promising young trainer saddled 2024 Breeders' Cup Turf runner-up Rousham Park.

RaceName: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: High-class horse at his best, winner of three Grade 1s, two in Argentina and California Crown Stakes at Santa Anita (1m1f) in September 2024; not the same force of old and tailed off in Grade 2 last time; opposed.

RaceName: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: ERJ Racing LLC & Reddam Racing LLC
Spotlight: Useful form, lightly raced; runner-up at Santa Anita in 2026 in allowance race and Grade 2 Hollywood Gold Cup (1m2f), in latter beaten nearly 10l by Forged Steel after latter established a clear early lead; needs to step up a good deal to defeat these.

RaceName: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Curlin colt who won Grade 3 Blame Stakes at Churchill Downs (1m1f) in May; stiffer task when well-beaten ninth in Grade 2 Suburban Stakes at Saratoga (1m2f) last time (Forged Steel fifth); this is more difficult still.

RaceName: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Late-running stamina glutton who got the perfect set-up in 2025 Dubai World Cup at Meydan (1m2f); creditable efforts this term when placed in Grade 3 Blame at Churchill Downs (1m1f; travelled strongly, short of room, caught eye in third) and Grade 2 Suburban at Saratoga (did best of the closers, 10l second to impressive front-runner Phileas Fogg); could get perfect set-up here with so much early pace signed on and looks to be coming to the boil.

RaceName: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: Slam Dunk Racing, Debby Baltas & Cynthia McClanahan
Spotlight: Clearly best effort to win five-runner Grade 1 Santa Anita Handicap (1m2f) in March by 5l from Vodka Vodka; disappointing since in Grade 3 at Keeneland and Grade 2 Hollywood Gold Cup (1m2f), in latter 10l behind Forged Steel; hard to trust.

RaceName: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: Bag Racing Stables, Miller Racing Et Al
Spotlight: In tremendous form, completing hat-trick in allowance at Gulfstream and Grade 3s at Pimlico (9.5f) and Prairie Meadows (9f); set strong pace and stayed on well to win by three and a half lengths from Bullard in Cornhusker Handicap on latter occasion; should give another good account but this is tougher.

RaceName: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: First home of the front-runners when third to Skippylongstocking in strongly run Grade 1 Pegasus World Cup at Gulfstream (1m1f) in January, then stumbled badly start when 3l fourth to Nu What's New in Grade 3 Oaklawn Mile in March; runner-up two years ago and looks to have been laid out (trainer has won this four times) but faces so much pressure up front.

RaceName: Pacific Classic Stakes (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: High-class horse, devastating in hat-trick of Grade 3 wins at Gulfstream last winter (all in very fast time); back to form when winning Grade 3 Monmouth Cup (1m1f) by just over 10l from Money Game; has lots of early pace but has to overcome wide draw, pace pressure and needs to prove stamina at 1m2f; highly respected but may start at cramped odds, considering difficulties.
