Sumbe Prix du Calvados (Group 2) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Supplemented for this; narrowly beaten on debut at Dieppe (5.5f, soft) before producing a far better effort on the figures when winning here over 6f earlier this month; step up in trip should be okay on pedigree.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix du Calvados (Group 2) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Debut winner at Chantilly (6f, very soft) which she followed with two sound efforts in Group 3 company, both of over 6f, albeit one time behind Yuquot; more than enough on dam side of pedigree to suggest she'll stay 7f.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix du Calvados (Group 2) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Not beaten far on debut at Saint-Cloud (7f, soft) and then won over same C&D on faster ground before a career best third over this C&D last time for the Group 3 Prix Six Perfections; no concerns about stamina and big chance.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix du Calvados (Group 2) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Won on debut at Thirsk (5f, good) in May for Michael Keady and then was beaten less than 6l as an 80-1 chance in the Group 3 Albany over C&D (good to firm); changed stables and improved again when runner-up in the Gp3 Princess Margaret (6f, good to firm) again at Ascot; should stay new trip.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix du Calvados (Group 2) (Fillies) (Turf)
OwnerName: Scuderia Chiolo, Meridian International SAS et al
Spotlight: Maiden but run a couple of good races on the figures here, the first time over 6f then 7f (good to firm ground), but this looks a tough task ask.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix du Calvados (Group 2) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Not added to her debut win yet but only run in Group 3s and Listed races since, mostly with plenty of credit without making much progress; should run her race but finished behind Woot Woot over C&D last time and doesn't have the scope some of her rivals have for improvement.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Kergorlay (Group 2) (Turf)
OwnerName: Alain Jathiere & Ecurie Haras Des Senora
Spotlight: Acts on most ground; 10yo who landed this race in 2022 and has finished runner-up to Double Major for the last two years; third of seven in a Listed event at Saint-Cloud (1m7f, good) in June and left the impression he's still in form at Clairefontaine last month; this hold-up performer has each-way claims.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Kergorlay (Group 2) (Turf)
Spotlight: Progressive 4yo who went close in the Ascot Stakes (2m4f, good to firm) in June before going one better with a likeable staying performance in a Goodwood handicap (2m4f, good to firm) last month, not for catching after kicking for home a fair way out; the drop back in trip isn't an obvious positive on his first go in Group company but, supplemented for this and has to be respected.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Kergorlay (Group 2) (Turf)
Spotlight: Improving stayer who has won six of his last eight starts, including a 1m7f Listed event at Saint-Cloud (good) in June; respectable fourth of six on his first go in Group 2 at Longchamp (1m6f, good to firm) last month (had Double Major ahead of him).

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Kergorlay (Group 2) (Turf)
Spotlight: Won this race in 2024 by 7l and held off Goya Senora by a short neck in this year's renewal; wasn't far off his best when sixth in the Prix Vicomtesse Vigier at Longchamp (1m7f, soft) in May but did have every chance when a close-up third in a Group 2 there last month (1m6f, good to firm); bids for a hat-trick of wins in this contest and he's respected.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Kergorlay (Group 2) (Turf)
Spotlight: Runner-up in the Prix de Royallieu at Longchamp (1m6f, very soft) on her final start last year and reappeared with a Group 2 success at Newmarket (1m4f, good to firm) in May; improved on that form when going close in the Prix Vicomtesse Vigier (1m7f, soft) next time and bounced back from a poor effort with a narrow defeat in the Lillie Langtry at Goodwood last time; leading contender.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Kergorlay (Group 2) (Turf)
Spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who won twice at Saint-Cloud over 1m4f in March/April (good to soft/soft), and progressed again when beaten a neck in a Listed event over this C&D this month on his first start for 113 days; this will require another step forward but he should still be capable of better after just five starts.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Bet On Great Repairs Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Latest race was voided just after halfway; still has low mileage and the time before he was third of eight in a 2m4f handicap at Uttoxeter, beaten 11l; now 0-6 over fences and he does look a tad high in the weights.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Bet On Great Repairs Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Regular winner in France; continues to hold his own for current connections and gave well-handicapped opposition something to think about in his last two races (2m4f, good); won over 2m5f in France but hasn't ventured any further; definite chance if getting home.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Bet On Great Repairs Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Remote third to Gata Ban here in June when in this headgear combination for the first time (retained since) but he won narrowly on his return visit and nearly followed up a month ago; 4lb higher than for that defeat but this lightly raced gelding has since had a wind operation.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Bet On Great Repairs Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Faced tough tasks in his first two chases (latest in November 2025) and returns to this discipline after winning narrowly over hurdles off this figure a month ago (2m7f, good); clearly on a workable mark if he can click over fences.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Bet On Great Repairs Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Back-to-back wins in 2025 in a 2m6f novice hurdle (good) and 3m handicap chase (good to soft) but below that level since returning from a break (hurdling for last two races) and has a bit to prove at present.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Bet On Great Repairs Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Won five handicap chases during 2024/2025, the latest off this mark; unable to win any small-field points this year but was bought for £10,000 in May and has joined Dan Skelton; has to be of interest after a wind operation, all the more so if strong in the betting.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Bet On Great Repairs Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Well handicapped on the best of his hurdle form (1-12) but that's for a reason and this is his chase debut; others safer.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Bet On Great Repairs Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: At the eighth attempt she comfortably opened her account as a chaser over C&D in early June and then defied a penalty at Fontwell (3m2f, good), though that was harder work in a four-runner race; 3lb higher this time but unlikely to be far away.

RaceName: Blackmore Building Contractors Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Back to form in refitted cheekpieces lately and has been placed on her last three starts; should be thereabouts once again.

RaceName: Blackmore Building Contractors Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Got off the mark when landing a classified at Yarmouth (11.5f, good to firm) last month; third when favourite back in handicaps at Yarmouth and Windsor this month and should give another good account.

RaceName: Blackmore Building Contractors Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Hasn't won for two years but regularly makes the frame; should not be far away but doesn't appeal for win purposes.

RaceName: Blackmore Building Contractors Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Both wins came when trained in Ireland in 2023; has made the frame in five of his last six races; returning cheekpieces replace visor but losing run is mounting up.

RaceName: Blackmore Building Contractors Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: Has made the frame on several occasions but remains a 19-race maiden; her mark continues to fall and she should find one of these soon.

RaceName: Blackmore Building Contractors Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
Spotlight: All four wins have been for previous trainers; hasn't yet gone forward from his opening third at Chepstow (1m2f, good to soft) in June for this yard.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Pinatubo filly cost 300,000euros at the Arqana breeze-ups; sent off 100-30 for her Leopardstown (7f, good) debut but was a shade disappointing in seventh; 3l to find with Miss Twilight on that initial outing but likely to improve.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Defied odds of 66-1 when finishing a head in front of Churchill Bond and 3l behind Miss Twilight at Leopardstown on debut when sixth (7f, good); that's something to build on.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: State Of Rest filly; 80,000gns yearling; second foal; dam ran once at 1m2f (RPR 66), sister to 8.6f Listed winner Up Helly AA, half-sister to French 7f/7.5f winner Innervisions, out of 1m Group1 winning half-sister to Italian 1m 2yo Group 3/US 1m2f Grade 2 winner Innit; market can sort trainer's two.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: No match for easy winner Folsom Blues at Gowran (7f, soft); fifth behind winning stablemate at Galway (7f, yielding) last time (3.75l behind Silver Kiss) after being bumped early on; Foley takes over now.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan
Spotlight: Sea The Moon filly; half-sister to 1m2f winner Reyenzi (RPR 108); dam unplaced 1m AW/9.4f turf (55), half-sister to winners Raydara (7f 2yo Group 2), Rondonia (1m/1m2f) and Rayna (1m3f/1m4f), out of 1m4f Listed winner; appears stable number one on jockey bookings.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Saxon Warrior filly; 95,000euros yearling; sixth foal; half-sister to winners Diagnostic (6f-7f AW; RPR 100), Homeopathic (7f AW 2yo/turf; 94), Wizard D'Amour (7f inc AW; 93) and Naturopath (Greek 6f); dam unraced sister to 6f Listed winner Prescription; best watched unless market speaks.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Finished 5.25l behind Miss Twilight on debut at Leopardstown (7f, good, 14-1); work to do.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: One of two for yard; Cracksman filly; 160,000euros yearling; dam Group-placed 5f 2yo winner (RPR 102), half-sister to winners Manaccan (5f Group 3), Raucous (6f Listed) and Green Fortune (6f inc 2yo), out of Group-placed 5f 2yo winner; market best guide.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Improved over a dismal Leopardstown debut when a 6l fifth of 13 over 1m at Dundalk eight days ago; others preferred all the same.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Debut third at Fairyhouse (6f, good) looks good subsequently given the winner, Livenka, won the Ballyhane Stakes next time and the runner-up won a maiden by 9l; filled the same spot at Galway last time (7f, yielding) and the second horse filled the same spot in a Listed race next time; chance.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Close second over this trip at Leopardstown, third has won since; disappointed over 7f at Galway last time but the yielding ground was possibly to blame; worth another go on good ground but this is a competitive race.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Well beaten at Galway on debut over 7f (yielding); much improvement needed.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Good first effort when chasing home the useful Livenka in the valuable Ballyhane Stakes at Naas despite a price of 100-1; withdrawn from a Cork Listed contest a couple of days ago due to coughing but clearly well thought of; shortlisted.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Triple-figure odds for all three maidens and makes little appeal on her form to date.

RaceName: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Ran a stormer on her debut when third of 12 at Leopardstown (7f, good), a neck behind a rival who won by 5l next time; could progress further with that run under her belt; interesting, but drawn wide.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Rapid Response Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Fairly treated and some fair efforts at 2m4f/2m5f before struggling back over 2m in a Class 2; that's readily forgiven and he'll probably run well.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Rapid Response Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Third over fences at Bangor on May reappearance (2m1f, good) but that mini revival was still well short of his peak efforts in 2025 and he ran no race back over hurdles at Cartmel (2m6f); unconvincing.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Rapid Response Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Front-runner who was granted an easy lead last time at Uttoxeter (2m4f, good) and made no mistake by 3l; hard to grumble with the 3lb rise and if getting into a rhythm he should put up another bold show.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Rapid Response Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner and competitive in handicaps for his previous yard, which he left for £22,000 and then underwent wind surgery; built for fences so no great surprise to see him justify favouritism at Uttoxter four weeks ago (2m4f, good); beat an in-form horse and would have done so more easily but for one notable mistake; big chance despite being raised 9lb.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Rapid Response Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Bumper and dual hurdle winner; second to a Skelton horse on his chase debut and last run here over 2m7f wasn't too bad as the front-runners never came back; each-way claims.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Rapid Response Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Capable chaser on his day having won two of his 16 races in this discipline but he's very up and down; others are safer.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Rapid Response Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: He was off his last winning mark when always prominent and doing it readily over C&D last time; should be a factor off 6lb higher.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Rapid Response Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Beaten nine times over hurdles but runner-up in four of those, including last time here over 2m4f in this new headgear combination; 5lb rise sees him on a career-high mark but he should make a chaser.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Rapid Response Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: All four chase wins came around 2m when trained by Dan Skelton; ran well on yard debut in December but little to show for his eight subsequent runs; has dropped to a dangerous mark, however.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Rapid Response Handicap Chase (Arc Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Miss Jayne Brace & Mrs Karen Smith
Spotlight: 0-8 over hurdles and 0-3 as a chaser; well behind At The Oche at Uttoxeter last time when the new cheekpieces made little difference.

RaceName: blackmorebuild.com EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Second run was better than his debut but he still finished last of the five runners; minor nurseries more suitable.

RaceName: blackmorebuild.com EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Rashid Faleh S T Alhajri Alhajri
Spotlight: Beaten in a seller and a claimer on his second and third runs for Archie Watson; much better form when second of 13 in a maiden at Windsor (5f, good to firm) ten weeks ago when tried in blinkers for the first time; sold for 14,000gns last month; cheekpieces the headgear of choice on stable debut; leading form claims and could provide his apprentice, who has enjoyed some success in Qatar, with a first British win at the first attempt.

RaceName: blackmorebuild.com EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: Hold My Beer, M Broughton & T Elphick
Spotlight: 50-1 when finishing down the field at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) 17 days ago; this is weaker but he will need a big step forward to win.

RaceName: blackmorebuild.com EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: She was finishing placed for the second time from seven starts when third at Lingfield (5f, AW) on Thursday; best turf run came on firm ground so the recent rain perhaps not ideal.

RaceName: blackmorebuild.com EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: She hasn't seen things out in a couple of 5f events this summer; still capable of better and Billy Loughnane's presence in the saddle suggests improvement could be forthcoming.

RaceName: blackmorebuild.com EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Went desperately close at Bath (5f, firm) last month but she failed to back it up when fourth returned to Bath 23 days ago; still has more to recommend her than most.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Morny (Group 1) (Turf)
OwnerName: AMO Racing Limited & Mrs A O'Callaghan
Spotlight: Made a winning debut at Navan (6f, good to yielding) in April and was a 3l second of seven in the Railway Stakes at the Curragh last month; however, he's been well held either side of that, including behind Orthodox and Carry The Flag in the Norfolk (5f, good to firm); others preferred.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Morny (Group 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Justified strong market confidence on his debut at Salisbury (5f, good) in May and backed that up with an impressive performance in the Norfolk (5f, good to firm), a race his trainer won with Reckless Abandon in 2012 before landing this contest; he's been off since having suffered a small setback but looks sure to have no problem with the step up to 6f; an exciting prospect; strong claims.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Morny (Group 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Narrowly beat Sun Goddess at Naas (5f, good) on his second start and also won a Listed race over that same C&D last month; 7l behind Orthodox in the Norfolk and he faded into fourth after making the running in the Phoenix Stakes (6f, good to firm) last time; has a bit to find to reverse placings with his old rival and there's a suspension he may be better over 5f.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Morny (Group 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Unbeaten colt; 6l winner on his debut at the Curragh (6f, soft) before following up in the Marble Hill (6f, good), getting the better of his stablemate Carry The Flag, and made it 3-3 when landing the Coventry (6f, good to firm); holes can be picked in that form but this colt can probably be marked up having raced in the far side group; has to be respected.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Morny (Group 1) (Turf)
OwnerName: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg
Spotlight: Off the mark when winning an 18-runner maiden at Naas (6f, good) last month and overcame trouble in-running to land the Richmond Stakes (6f, good to firm) at Goodwood eight days later; he's progressed with each start and is the choice of Ryan Moore; strong claims.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Morny (Group 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Finished behind Senorita Bonita when midfield in the Queen Mary on her second start before going down by a length in a Listed event here of 5f (good to soft); stayed on strongly to get off the mark in a similar event here last time (again over 5f) suggesting step up to this trip would suit; each-way claims.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Morny (Group 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Quickened up well to make a winning debut at Nottingham (5f, good) in June; ran a big race when second of 27 in the Queen Mary (5f, good to firm) and appreciated the step up to this trip when landing the Duchess Of Cambridge Stakes at Newmarket last month; that form was well franked by Libertango in the Lowther on Thursday and this filly is a leading contender for a stable that won this with Vandeek in 2023.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Morny (Group 1) (Turf)
Spotlight: Unbeaten filly, winning twice at Saint-Cloud (6f; good/good to soft) in May before making it 3-3 with a stylish performance in a Group 3 over this C&D last time (good); this well-bred filly is an exciting prospect and makes the shortlist.

RaceName: Matchbook Exchange Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Beaten 22l on debut at Leopardstown (7f, good, 50-1); best to look elsewhere despite added hood.

RaceName: Matchbook Exchange Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: No Nay Never filly; 250,000euros yearling; eighth foal; half-sister to winners Prague (1m/1m2f inc Group 2; RPR 118), Knight Of Honour (1m1f-1m6f inc Bahrain; 95), Glyfada (1m/10.4f; 94) and Princess Nadia (1m2f; 86); dam 6f 2yo winner (inc Group 3/AW; 110); nice pedigree and worth checking in the market.

RaceName: Matchbook Exchange Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Dropped away to finish in rear when 66-1 for her debut at Fairyhouse; improved effort when a 4.25l eighth of 16 at Cork last time (5f, good); more needed all the same.

RaceName: Matchbook Exchange Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Finished first in a barrier trial; excellent effort in a Cork maiden (6f, good) when beaten 0.5l into second by subsequent Group 3 winner Ballinea Star; didn't improve at Galway (7f, yielding) when fourth but it was still a creditable effort; should be thereabouts again.

RaceName: Matchbook Exchange Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan
Spotlight: Mehmas filly; half-sister to 6f 2yo/7f AW winner Dublin Bay (RPR 91); dam twice-raced maiden (78), out of US 9.5f Grade 3 winning sister to Australian 1m4f Group 2 winner Yucatan, is granddaughter of triple 1m Group 1 winner Six Perfections; Pink Venom appears to be the stable's main hope.

RaceName: Matchbook Exchange Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Westerberg & Mrs Magnier & M Tabor & D Smith
Spotlight: Should improve from an initial run at Fairyhouse (6f, good) where she was tenderly handled; race won by the useful-looking Livenka.

RaceName: Matchbook Exchange Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Starman filly was purchased for 360,000euros at a breeze-up in May; sister to Qatari 6.5f 2yo winner Smartman; dam unraced half-sister to 5f/6f Group 1 winner Fairyland and Australian 7f Group 2 winner Now Or Never, out of unraced half-sister to 6f-7f Group 1 winner Dream Ahead; of obvious interest if market support arrives.

RaceName: Matchbook Exchange Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Dam unraced half-sister to winners Grandmaster Flash (useful 1m4f/2m) and Glens Top Cat (Australian 1m2f-1m7f), out of 1m4f winning half-sister to 7f/1m Group 3 winner Purr Along; best watched.

RaceName: Matchbook Exchange Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: St Mark's Basilica filly; 105,000euros yearling, 190,000euros 2yo; third foal; half-sister to winners Midnight Tango (Group-placed 6f 2yo; RPR 104) and Fernando (1m 2yo; 73); dam Group-placed 6f 2yo winner (103), half-sister to 5f Group 1 winner Makarova; interesting newcomer and worth a market check.

RaceName: Matchbook Exchange Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: One of two for yard; showed the benefit of an initial run (seventh of ten at Leopardstown) when third at Fairyhouse (6f, good); could challenge for the money.

RaceName: Matchbook Exchange Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Shaped as though this trip was what she wanted when running on late for third over 5f here in June (good), second, fourth and fifth subsequently won a maiden; big player.

RaceName: Matchbook Exchange Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: The hood she wore for her debut over this trip at Dundalk is discarded after she finished 12th of 14 (150-1); ruled out.

RaceName: Matchbook Exchange Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Half-sister to US 5f/6.5f turf winner Sorrento Sky; unraced dam out of unraced half-sister to 5f Listed winner Our Little Secret (dam of 5f Group 2 winner Pearl Secret); likely best watched.

RaceName: Matchbook Exchange Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Unlikely to feature based on two moderate efforts to date.

RaceName: Matchbook Exchange Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Sioux Nation filly; fifth foal; half-sister to 5f-8.5f winner Wakanaka (inc 2yo/Canadian Grade 2/Italian Group 3; RPR 105); dam 5f winner (71), out of 5f 2yo winner closely related to useful 5f-7f winner Green Park, half-sister to 5f 2yo Group 3 winner Whitbarrow; market can guide.

RaceName: Matchbook Exchange Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Mehmas filly; third foal; dam 6f 2yo winner (RPR 88), sister to 1m-1m2f winner Dance Of Fire, half-sister to 7f Group 3 winners Dancing Star and Foxtrot Lady, is granddaughter of Nunthorpe-winning half-sister to top-class sprinter Lochsong; best watched on debut.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Neigh Bad Repairs Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Unseated midrace in his first point and then a 6l runner-up in the second; likely best watched.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Neigh Bad Repairs Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Ninth foal from a prolific family; 40-1 at Uttoxeter where he bucked repeatedly and unseated rider soon after the start; moved yards but with the same owners.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Neigh Bad Repairs Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Bought for £15,000 in May soon after winning a point bumper and a 2m4f point; tongue-tie fitted for rules debut; has some proven ability.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Neigh Bad Repairs Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 20,000euros foal; third foal; dam maiden pointer, half-sister to winners Nom De Guerre (2m4f hurdle/3m1f chase) and Guts For Garters (3m-4m hurdle/chase); had wind surgery; stable has bumper winners and Brian Hughes is booked.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Neigh Bad Repairs Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Well held in two Uttoxeter bumpers for Paul Collins; has since had wind surgery.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Neigh Bad Repairs Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: First foal; dam point and 2m3f hurdle/3m chase winner, out of unraced half-sister to 2m hurdle winner The Irregular, from family of top-class staying chaser Any Second Now; bred to have a future and no surprise should this newcomer have a part to play.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Neigh Bad Repairs Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Outpaced but kept on for second on good ground here three months ago and that was a likeable start; should feature.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Neigh Bad Repairs Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Seventh foal; half-sister to winners Another Mystery (point and 2m5f-3m hurdle/chase), Percy De Courcy and Misstree Song (both points); dam point winner/placed 2m2f-3m hurdles; in the Skelton yard and she's a 4yo filly with her allowances.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Neigh Bad Repairs Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Finished closer on second run at Southwell in May but was still about 10l off the winner; more needed.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Neigh Bad Repairs Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Beaten 16l here and then about 12l at Stratford when last of the seven; opposable.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Neigh Bad Repairs Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Got a soft lead when making all at Stratford but folded tamely next time at Uttoxeter; however, as a past winner and now ridden by Harry Cobden, she has to be respected.

RaceName: John Heal Memorial Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: 2-2 since switched to nurseries, both wins coming in Class 6 events at Chepstow (5f-6f, good to firm); latest 7lb rise asks a stiffer question but she could still have more in the tank.

RaceName: John Heal Memorial Nursery Handicap
OwnerName: K Shenton, N Bradley 6 & D Cunha
Spotlight: Appreciated the drop to Class 6 company when making all in a 6f nursery at Catterick (good ground) on Monday; there was plenty of money for him ahead of that success and he should give it a good go under a 6lb penalty.

RaceName: John Heal Memorial Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: She hasn't progressed from her promising debut but it was a stronger nursery in which she finished fifth at Yarmouth (5f, good to firm) last month; down 2lb and could yet fare better.

RaceName: John Heal Memorial Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Clear promise in his three starts, albeit he could only manage fifth when the 2-1 favourite for a 6f Kempton nursery 18 days ago; that doesn't tell the whole story though as he was messed about at the start, poorly positioned as a result and then ran the fastest sectionals for the third, fourth and fifth furlongs before his effort petered out close home; capable of better.

RaceName: John Heal Memorial Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: 6f win at Ripon in April; poor runs on last four starts, tailed off when 150-1 for the Kempton nursery in which Crowned finished fifth 18 days ago; handicap mark in freefall but has a point to prove.

RaceName: John Heal Memorial Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Little solid form in six starts; the addition of blinkers is not enough to tempt.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Jean et Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Spotlight: Seventh in this last year, but does have a Listed and a Group 3 win in her profile, plus has been placed at the top level in America and France; didn't need to be at her best to win at Chantilly last time (1m2f110yds, good) but posted a career best at Saratoga prior to that; this is a strong race but she should be in the mix for a place at least.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Jean et Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Spotlight: Winner of a Listed race and Group 3 in Ireland last year over a mile and 1m1f but yet to strike over this distance from four starts, although she's run in decent races every time; heads into this off a career best in the Pretty Polly Stakes (1m2f, good to firm) and should run her race; seems to handle all ground.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Jean et Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Spotlight: Capable of smart form, notably when winning the Group 2 Prix de Malleret (1m4f, good to soft) from a decent type last July, but last two starts have been modest and she didn't beat a rival in a York Listed event 30 days ago; bit to prove now.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Jean et Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Spotlight: Classy type, who spends most of her time in Group 1 company, more than often running with plenty of credit; drop to a Group 2 saw her win at Longchamp in May (1m2f110yds, good to soft) and should be involved from her low draw.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Jean et Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Spotlight: Only made debut in December and has come a long way since, her best run coming when beaten a short-neck by Diamond Necklace in the Prix de Diane (1m2f110yd, good to firm) in June; bumped into another top prospect last time in a 1m4f Group 2 and likely to play a part unless those two efforts have taken something out of her; respected.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Jean et Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Spotlight: Had plenty of racing for her age, winning five of her ten starts, and recorded a career best last time on her first try over 1m2f when beaten a nose in the Group 1 Grosser Dallmayr-Preis on good ground; back in against just her own sex and capable of featuring if building on that Munich effort; seems to handle all underfoot conditions.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Jean et Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Spotlight: Won on debut at Gowran in April, when she had stablemate Johanna Walsh back in third, and then went on to land a Group 3 at Naas (1m2f84yds, good); couldn't maintain her superiority over Johanna Walsh last time in the Irish Oaks (1m4f, good to firm) but drop back in trip looks the right move after that; interesting.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Jean et Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
OwnerName: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor
Spotlight: Won a Group 2 on her second start as a 2yo and then was Group 1 placed, but struggled since, including in the Irish Oaks last time, and stable have much stronger claims with Diamond Necklace.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Jean et Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Spotlight: Smart sort and did gain a career best when third in a 1m1f Group 3 last time, but this is a very hard task unless the new trip brings about lots of improvement from wide draw.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Jean et Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
OwnerName: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith
Spotlight: Long prices when behind stablemate Diamond Necklace the last two times, and probably in here to make a good pace, albeit she's coming out of stall 11.

RaceName: Sumbe Prix Jean et Louis Romanet (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
OwnerName: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg
Spotlight: Faultless profile when considering she's unbeaten in six starts, three of them in France and the last four of which have been at Group 1 level; won the Poule d'Essai Des Pouliches, Prix de Diane (Pink Panthera runner-up) and Nassau Stakes this campaign so, with no ground or trip concerns, she's clearly the one to beat.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Sioux Nation colt; 50,000gns yearling; dam unraced half-sister to winners King Leonidas (useful 7f 2yo/1m), Ziryab (7.5f-10.7f inc Australia) and Rasmee (12.4f), out of UAE 9.5f Listed winner; yard not known for debut 2yo winners.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 25-1 and weakened in the closing stages on debut at Leopardstown (6.5f, good); much more needed.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Far from disgraced on debut at Cork (5f, gd-fm) when ducking left at the start but finishing just 2.75l behind the 95 rated Hanney Boy, to whom he was conceding 4lb; dam won over 6f as a 2yo so this longer trip should be fine; chance.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Ran a cracker on debut over C&D (good) for Josh Halley, travelling sweetly and beaten just 2.25l into second behind subsequent Goodwood Group 2 winner Man's Best Friend; has since joined Donnacha O'Brien and obvious chance here.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Mrs J Barrett & Mrs Paul Shanahan & Mrs M V Magnier
Spotlight: Starspangledbanner filly; E70,000 yearling; dam placed 6f turf/7f AW (RPR 76), half-sister to winners Roulston Scar (useful 5f-6f), Special Purpose (useful 5f 2yo) and Rising Power (5f/6f 2yo); yard can ready one and some appeal on paper; check market.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Mohammed Bin Hamad Khalifa Al Attiyah
Spotlight: 200-1 and didn't show a whole lot on debut at Galway; may need more time and experience.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Unfortunately gelding; E20,000 yearling; half-brother to winners Tomahawk King (7f AW 2yo; RPR 76), Berry Edge (1m1f/1m2f Flat inc AW, 74; 2m hurdle) and Al Zaker (Hungarian 7f); dam 1m winner; likely best watched.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Starspangledbanner filly; E45,000 yearling; half-sister to four winners inc Assail (9.4f-1m4f inc AW; RPR 96), Sarsons Risk (1m4f/2m Flat inc AW, 90; 2m hurdle) and Glengowan (1m 2yo; 85); dam 1m4f winner (82); may need further in time.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Starspangledbanner filly; E28,000 foal, E40,000 yearling; dam 6f winner (RPR 76), sister to winners Broken Stones (Group-placed 6f 2yo) and Usra (Listed-placed 5f 2yo), half-sister to 1m 2yo/1m2f winner Piecederesistance; market best guide.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Elzaam gelding; E7,500 yearling; half-brother to 5f 2yo winner Call Me Harswell (RPR 78); dam unplaced, half-sister to US 1m Grade 1 winner River Boyne; best watched unless the market speaks.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Gerard Clarke/Seven Plus One Syndicate/Patrick McGuinness
Spotlight: Yard in fine form but this gelding didn't pull up any trees on debut at Navan last month; much more needed.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: John G Hennessy & C Acheson & Mrs John Harrington
Spotlight: Calyx filly; E36,000 yearling; half-sister to winners Universal Girl (South African 6f) and Future Promise (Danish 7.7f); dam unraced sister to 1m1f Listed winner Qazyna, half-sister to Australian 1m4f Group 2 winner Au Revoir; market can reveal expectations.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Left form of previous two runs behind when almost springing a 50-1 surprise at the Curragh (6f, good) a week ago; this is probably a better race so she'll need to improve further if she is to get her head in front.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Sergei Prokofiev filly; 27,000GBP breeze-up purchase; dam placed 6f 2yo/7f (RPR 72), out of 1m1f/1m2f winning sister to 1m4f/2m Group 3 winner Nayef Road; mix of speed and stamina in pedigree; probably best watched unless backed.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Minzaal filly; E15,000 breeze-up purchase; dam 1m winner (RPR 84), half-sister to winners Shaden (6f 2yo Group 3) and I'll Be Your Clown (1m2f-10.5f Flat/2m hurdle), out of Listed-placed 5f 2yo winner; likely best watched.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Phils Last Shift Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: Placed in a pair of Irish points; brought along steadily over hurdles, catching the eye under a considerate ride when fifth of seven in 2m Uttoxeter novice in May; hood goes on; capable of better after a break.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Phils Last Shift Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: A fairly useful 1m4f Flat winner for Harry Charlton in 2024; not so good in that sphere for his current yard and came in last of six in 1m6f Newmarket handicap 15 days ago; hurdle debut.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Phils Last Shift Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: A modest 1m2f Flat scorer in April; 40-1, hinted at promise with fifth of nine in novice over C&D on hurdling debut last month; can build on it here.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Phils Last Shift Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: Placed in a bumper here last October; yet to offer much in a pair of maiden hurdles over C&D this summer.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Phils Last Shift Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: Fair ex-Irish maiden hurdler who signed off for Martin Brassil with good third of 13 in 2m6f Tramore maiden in May; not ruled out for his new yard after a break.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Phils Last Shift Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: Useful bumper scorer but he failed to build on a promising start in this sphere for Gordon Elliott, pulled up in maiden hurdles on his last two runs early in 2026; changed hands for 4,000gns since and has plenty to prove for his new yard with a hood fitted.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Phils Last Shift Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: Fair maiden on the Flat for Andrew Oliver; has shown promise in this sphere for Dan Skelton, in the frame in juveniles at Newbury and Ascot before making late errors when fifth of eight in 2m Ludlow juvenile in February; has since undergone wind surgery and holds leading form claims.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Phils Last Shift Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: A dual winner (at up to 1m4f) on the Flat in Ireland for Stuart Crawford last June; changed hands for 58,000gns and showed promise on his yard/hurdling debut in 2m Southwell maiden in May, still in third when falling last; open to progress.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Phils Last Shift Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: Fifth in bumper here on his debut in June but again tongue tied when a well-held ninth in C&D novice on his hurdling debut the following month; this son of Walk In The Park fetched 140,000euros as a 3yo and could still do better.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Phils Last Shift Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: Dartmouth gelding; fair form shown when placed in a pair of juvenile hurdles in December, sticking to his task well when runner-up at Lingfield (2m) on latter occasion; likely capable of better and not out of things on his seasonal return.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Phils Last Shift Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB)
Spotlight: Built on debut seventh with fourth of nine in 2m1f bumper at Newton Abbot last month; no forlorn hope now going hurdling.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Phils Last Shift Maiden Hurdle (Arc Summer Novices' Brush Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB)
HorseName: Snow Is In The Sky IRE
Spotlight: A winning Irish pointer but she's offered little in a pair of maiden hurdles at Southwell (2m) and Chepstow (19.5f) in March; significantly more is required.

RaceName: Blackmore Equestrian Construction Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Final)
Spotlight: Another seemingly exposed sort to be galvanised by a move to James Owen, winning fast-ground handicaps here (7f), Yarmouth (1m) and Newmarket (7f); beaten favourite at Chepstow last time when running off a 9lb lower mark than today's; drops back to 6f with her hood discarded.

RaceName: Blackmore Equestrian Construction Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Final)
Spotlight: The winner of five races this summer, latterly getting the better of Prefer The Sister over 7f here last month (6lb better off with that rival today); well drawn to attack but could help set this up for a finisher.

RaceName: Blackmore Equestrian Construction Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Final)
Spotlight: Only midfield in this race 12 months ago when rated 3lb lower; she found only an unexposed 3yo too strong at Epsom 24 days ago and holds each-way claims again.

RaceName: Blackmore Equestrian Construction Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Final)
Spotlight: Three turf wins (fast ground) since rejoining Tony Carroll, one of them coming over C&D; up in the weights as a result and the recent rain will suit others more.

RaceName: Blackmore Equestrian Construction Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Final)
Spotlight: Had been expensive to follow but he ended a losing run at Chepstow (6f, good to firm) two weeks ago when more positive tactics were deployed; unpenalised when bolting up back at Chepstow on Tuesday and he is effectively 11lb higher today; slower ground shouldn't be an issue but this will require a good deal more.

RaceName: Blackmore Equestrian Construction Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Final)
Spotlight: Multiple course winner, the latest 18 days ago when he was far too strong for five rivals over 5.3f (good to firm); up 6lb in a deeper race but still feasibly weighted.

RaceName: Blackmore Equestrian Construction Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Final)
Spotlight: On a good mark and this is weaker than the races he has contested on his last three starts; a well-run 6f shouldn't be a problem and he is a key player despite his wide stall.

RaceName: Blackmore Equestrian Construction Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Final)
Spotlight: Prominent racer; three wins this year, including here, but put in his place by Secret Handsheikh 18 days ago; others appeal more.

RaceName: Blackmore Equestrian Construction Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Final)
Spotlight: Not been with Chris Gordon for long and he has run two good races for the yard, finishing second at Windsor before getting the better of Washington Heir over 5.3f here 16 days ago; whether he can prove quite so effective over 6f remains to be seen.

RaceName: Blackmore Equestrian Construction Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Final)
Spotlight: C&D wins in two of his last three starts, the latest his stable debut 16 days ago when he wore a tongue-tie for the first time; a 3lb rise shouldn't prevent another big run.

RaceName: Blackmore Equestrian Construction Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Final)
OwnerName: Homecroft Wealth, Paul J Dixon & Partners
Spotlight: Front-runner; knocking at the door on turf this summer but he's 0-14 on the grass and he's unlikely to get his own way up front in this field.

RaceName: Blackmore Equestrian Construction Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Final)
Spotlight: Off the mark in a 0-50 classified event here in June and he has run well in defeat here twice since; still improving and that doesn't apply to too many in this field.

RaceName: Blackmore Equestrian Construction Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Final)
Spotlight: Doesn't find winning easy and he has been well short of his best on his last three starts; others have stronger claims.

RaceName: Blackmore Equestrian Construction Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Final)
Spotlight: Won a classified event over C&D last month; only fourth back in handicap company 16 days ago and this demands more.

RaceName: Blackmore Equestrian Construction Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Final)
Spotlight: 27-race maiden; close third here in June came in a 0-50 classified event; easy enough to swerve.

RaceName: Blackmore Equestrian Construction Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Final)
Spotlight: Poor strike-rate, including 0-26 on turf; unlikely to be righting that wrong from 5lb out of the weights.

RaceName: Tally-Ho Stud Irish EBF Ballyogan Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: 4yo hasn't won since her 2yo days but not beaten far the last twice, in a Group 3 at Leopardstown (7f, good) and when a 3l fourth of 15 in a Listed contest over C&D (good) a month ago (behind Soul Love and Dancing Saxon); a fair bit to find on the figures with a few of these.

RaceName: Tally-Ho Stud Irish EBF Ballyogan Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: 4yo represents last year's winning yard; four-time winner including at Listed and Group 3 level; slow start to this season but back on song when denied by a neck by Flora Of Bermuda in a York Group 3 (6f, gd-fm) last month; firmly enters calculations now.

RaceName: Tally-Ho Stud Irish EBF Ballyogan Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Has been highly tried to no avail since winning a C&D handicap in May last year off 75; not disgraced in 7f Listed race at Cork last time out but this looks too demanding.

RaceName: Tally-Ho Stud Irish EBF Ballyogan Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Successive handicap wins at Down Royal (7f, soft) and Fairyhouse (6f, good) earlier this summer; shaped okay on first try in Listed company over C&D on penultimate (behind Soul Love and Dancing Saxon) and not disgraced over 7f at Cork in another Listed race on latest; needs more upped in grade.

RaceName: Tally-Ho Stud Irish EBF Ballyogan Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Enjoying a fine campaign; won a 6.5f (good) rated race at Limerick on seasonal return; got to within 0.5l of Soul Love when second of 15 in C&D Listed race here last month; regained the winning thread in impressive fashion off favourable mark in a 7f (yielding) Galway handicap; progressive and should be thereabouts again.

RaceName: Tally-Ho Stud Irish EBF Ballyogan Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Well held behind a few of these in C&D Listed race won by Soul Love last month; beaten off 80 in Curragh handicap on latest; up against it in this company.

RaceName: Tally-Ho Stud Irish EBF Ballyogan Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Last season's Cheveley Park runner up didn't have to be at her best to win the Group 3 Lacken Stakes here back in May; only beaten 2l when a fine fourth in the Commonwealth Cup at Royal Ascot; didn't fire dropped to 5f in a Curragh Group 2 on latest; likely to rebound stepped back up in trip and gets 3yo weight allowance.

RaceName: Tally-Ho Stud Irish EBF Ballyogan Stakes (Group 3) (Fillies & Mares)
Spotlight: Two wins last season including at Listed level at Goodwood (6f, good); fine third in York Group 3 on seasonal return (1.5l behind First Instinct); had a few of these rivals behind when taking a Listed race over C&D in July; gets 3yo weight allowance and likely to be on the premises again.

RaceName: You Spindle Me Rightround Baby Rightround Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Pulled up when last seen over hurdles at Uttoxeter (2m) in May but has won on the Flat since at Yarmouth; not out of things if back on his A-game.

RaceName: You Spindle Me Rightround Baby Rightround Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Gained a first success in 2m Stratford handicap in June and easily resumed winning ways in four-runner novice (2m1f) at Newton Abbot on Saturday; can go very well again back in handicap company.

RaceName: You Spindle Me Rightround Baby Rightround Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: A dual hurdles winner (including over C&D) last season; shaped well on his return when runner-up over C&D in June but failed to beat a rival back here last time; the sort to bounce back though.

RaceName: You Spindle Me Rightround Baby Rightround Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: A fairly useful ex-French bumper winner; got off the mark for current yard in maiden over C&D in June and not discredited when fifth on her handicap debut in steadily-run contest over C&D last time; she could still do better granted a likely stiffer test of stamina here.

RaceName: You Spindle Me Rightround Baby Rightround Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Free-going sort who gained a first success in this sphere over C&D in September but she ended the season below par; freshened up since and no surprise to see her get back on track after a layoff.

RaceName: You Spindle Me Rightround Baby Rightround Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Bagged a second C&D success in May and has posted good efforts when runner-up over C&D and at Market Rasen (2m) since; up 2lb but he enters calculations once more.

RaceName: You Spindle Me Rightround Baby Rightround Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Made a winning start for Fergal O'Brien over C&D (form been franked) in July and shaped as if still in good form when sixth of 12 over 2m4f at Market Rasen since, fading from two out; interesting back at 2m.

RaceName: You Spindle Me Rightround Baby Rightround Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Has proved unreliable but he resumed winning ways at Uttoxeter (2m) in July and followed up with another 2m handicap win there 30 days ago, overhauling Ocean Heights late on; not taken lightly in his current mood.

RaceName: You Spindle Me Rightround Baby Rightround Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Brought along steadily last season; off seven months and failed to progress on his handicap debut with eighth of ten to Cawthorne Banker at Uttoxeter (2m) last month; this son of Telescope could still do better though for good yard.

RaceName: You Spindle Me Rightround Baby Rightround Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Ex-French winner who capitalised on a reduced mark when gaining a first success for current yard at Newton Abbot (2m2f) in July; backed it up with a solid third (off a 7lb higher mark) in 2m1f Cartmel handicap since; can make his presence felt eased 1lb.

RaceName: You Spindle Me Rightround Baby Rightround Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: A fair 1m4f Flat winner last May; yet to score in this sphere but comes here on the back of a good second of eight to Cawthorne Banker in 2m Uttoxeter handicap 30 days ago; enjoys a 4lb weights pull here so very much one to consider.

RaceName: You Spindle Me Rightround Baby Rightround Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Only modest form shown in his three runs to date, coming in a never-dangerous fifth of seven in C&D novice last month; cheekpieces go on for his handicap debut with more required.

RaceName: You Spindle Me Rightround Baby Rightround Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: Mr & Mrs R Newiss & Gavin Teversham
Spotlight: A four-time Flat winner (at up to 1m2f); gained a first hurdling win at Uttoxeter (2m) last May and back on track with third of eight to Cawthorne Banker at Uttoxeter (2m) last time; needs to reproduce it here.

RaceName: You Spindle Me Rightround Baby Rightround Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Back to winning ways in 2m Uttoxeter handicap in May and largely in good form since over hurdles; made mistakes when last of eight on his chasing debut at Market Rasen (2m1f) eight days ago and not discounted quickly returned to this sphere.

RaceName: Blackmore Design & Build Handicap
Spotlight: Three wins for James Owen this year, the latest over 1m here (good to firm) 18 days ago; a 2lb rise shouldn't prevent another prominent showing.

RaceName: Blackmore Design & Build Handicap
Spotlight: Last year's heroics were always going to be a tough act to follow but the addition of cheekpieces, allied to a reduced mark, have seen an upturn in his fortunes since June; latest Windsor second (1m, good to firm; stable debut) wasn't far off his best and he's high on the list with Billy Loughnane aboard for the first time.

RaceName: Blackmore Design & Build Handicap
Spotlight: Prominent racer; in better forrm than his figures might suggest and he is only 2lb higher than when dominating a Class 3, albeit a weak one, at Lingfield in May; one of two runners for Tony Carroll.

RaceName: Blackmore Design & Build Handicap
Spotlight: Won three 7f handicaps last season; generally underperformed in 2026 but his Newmarket fourth in June came off a 4lb higher mark; change of headgear today.

RaceName: Blackmore Design & Build Handicap
Spotlight: Hasn't won the races one of his ability should; 4lb lower than for his winning start for Stuart Williams in January (7f, AW) but that wasn't a springboard to better things; sold for 8,500gns this month; goes without headgear on first run for Tony Carroll; not sure what to expect.

RaceName: Blackmore Design & Build Handicap
Spotlight: 6f maiden win last summer; up and down in handicaps since, running her best race of this campaign when third at Nottingham (6f, good to firm; cheekpieces first time) in June; sold for 14,000gns last month; headgear discarded and quickly stepped up in trip.

RaceName: Blackmore Design & Build Handicap
Spotlight: Four C&D wins to his name, the latest in June off 4lb lower; an easy lead would seem unlikely and this opposition may prove too demanding.

RaceName: Big Evs At Tally-Ho Handicap
Spotlight: Four-time winner (three at this trip) on good ground; poor form shown in her last three outings but drops into this lower grade for the first time since April 2025, and that resulted in a victory, so don't rule her out.

RaceName: Big Evs At Tally-Ho Handicap
Spotlight: Worked his way up the placings from third at Bellewstown to second at Down Royal before winning here last time, all over 5f on good; had a few of these behind him when winning; up 7lb but Paddy Harnett is entitled to use his 3lb claim this time, so that helps; in the mix.

RaceName: Big Evs At Tally-Ho Handicap
Spotlight: Showed modest form in four starts for Archie Watson; rating of 60 may flatter him; best watched on stable debut.

RaceName: Big Evs At Tally-Ho Handicap
Spotlight: Showed some promise in Britain at two; not beaten too far on yard debut in a Curragh handicap off 7lb higher after a slow start; shade disappointing in maiden company at Dundalk last time; interesting to see what position she occupies in the market.

RaceName: Big Evs At Tally-Ho Handicap
Spotlight: Nine-time winner, five on turf; latest win came here over 6f in May 2025 off 8lb higher; good runs in defeat over C&D this term, the best when runner-up off 1lb higher in June; fourth here last time when 3.25l behind Dandy Land; don't rule him out.

RaceName: Big Evs At Tally-Ho Handicap
Spotlight: Best form in 2022, winning three times in a July-to-September spell, and rising to a career-high mark of 94; frustrating in recent seasons; joined Peter Fahey late last year after a claiming-race third on AW; stumbled out of the stalls over 7f at Leopardstown earlier this month, left with too much to do; capable of better.

RaceName: Big Evs At Tally-Ho Handicap
Spotlight: All seven wins came over 6f (has run well at 5f) and six of them on AW; turf breakthrough in June when scoring at Fairyhouse (6f, good) by 2.5l off 3lb lower; moderate efforts since, including when beaten by 5.5l at Cork last time (6f, good to firm); others preferred.

RaceName: Big Evs At Tally-Ho Handicap
Spotlight: Now 0-15 and was beaten 20l in a Dundalk claimer when last seen in September (6f); new stable but best watched.

RaceName: Big Evs At Tally-Ho Handicap
Spotlight: Ran her best race on stable debut for a third trainer over 5f at Cork nine days ago when sent off the 11-4 favourite and keeping on late for second; that was a first run for 125 days, she's out again quickly but interesting if her supporters return.

RaceName: Big Evs At Tally-Ho Handicap
Spotlight: Ran her best race when staying-on sixth in a C&D fillies' maiden last year; poor since but some positives in her 5.5l seventh of 12 at Cork (5f, good) last time; down 3lb but others preferred.

RaceName: Big Evs At Tally-Ho Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time winner at Dundalk over 5f/6f but 0-16 on turf; remains 2lb above her last winning mark and not as effective on this surface.

RaceName: Big Evs At Tally-Ho Handicap
Spotlight: Winless from 34 starts but has been consistent this year from 5f to 7f; beaten 1.75l into fifth at Down Royal on penultimate (5f, good) but below his best at Cork (6f, good to firm); place chance at his best.

RaceName: Big Evs At Tally-Ho Handicap
Spotlight: Unseen for over a year after finishing in midfield in a Navan 5f handicap in April last year (soft); down 12lb compared to that and this is a lower grade, so worth a look in the market.

RaceName: Big Evs At Tally-Ho Handicap
Spotlight: A 6f Laytown winner in September off 46; five wins at 6f/7f; has never run over this trip so may lack the speed to match some of these, especially returning from a 331-day absence.

RaceName: Big Evs At Tally-Ho Handicap
Spotlight: All four wins came over 5f/6f at Navan; out of form until taking the third spot behind Dandy Land and Steel Magnolia over C&D last time (good); nudged up 2lb but won off a mark of 51 in October; needs to back up that latest positive run.

RaceName: Big Evs At Tally-Ho Handicap
Spotlight: Won a Bellewstown handicap in October (5f, soft) off 2lb higher; running well in defeat this season, not least when runner-up behind her reopposing stablemate Dandy Land over C&D last time (good); 1.25l to find with that rival but better off at the weights; suited by softer.

RaceName: Big Evs At Tally-Ho Handicap
Spotlight: Didn't show much in three maidens for John O'Neill; goes handicapping now for new yard but probably best watched.

RaceName: Big Evs At Tally-Ho Handicap
Spotlight: Soundly beaten in three deep maidens and didn't improve for switch to handicaps at Cork last month (6f, good to firm, 50-1).

RaceName: Big Evs At Tally-Ho Handicap
Spotlight: Sole win came in a 6f Curragh handicap off 53 in 2024; failed to beat a rival in a Navan handicap nor a Fairyhouse claimer in what were his final two starts for his former yard; hood goes on now but hard to fancy.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Best Repairs Hands Down Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Justified favouritism at Perth in April (2m4f, good) on return from a long absence but fared nothing like so well at Market Rasen a month ago; she's consistent in the main and could bounce back; 5lb higher than for that recent win; non-runner at Newton Abbot yesterday.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Best Repairs Hands Down Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Useful Flat performer for the Crisfords; has made a solid start over hurdles, winning over 2m here and then fourth when penalised at Uttoxeter; should have a future off this sort of mark.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Best Repairs Hands Down Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Close fourth in the Imperial Cup at Sandown (2m, good to soft) in March 2025 and very well handicapped on that form; not shown much in just four subsequent runs but couldn't discount.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Best Repairs Hands Down Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a 2m maiden here last August (good) and has been threatening in handicaps, including at this trip; doesn't appear to have much up his sleeve off this mark but has each-way credentials.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Best Repairs Hands Down Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Ran okay in the new visor last time at Cartmel but ran better the time before in a Class 4 at Newton Abbot and he's now back in that grade; Sam Twiston-Davies takes over from a claimer.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Best Repairs Hands Down Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Had a very eye-catching piece of form in 2023 when based in France; back from a mammoth absence this summer and he made all for wins at Dieppe and Clairefontaine (2m3f+); has left Noel George & Amanda Zetterholm; seems to enjoy soft/heavy ground, which is a concern.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Best Repairs Hands Down Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: Case Racing Partnership & Anita J Lush
Spotlight: Irish maiden hurdle winner; five runs for this yard, the best last time at Uttoxeter when about 12l off the winner; could improve on that.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Best Repairs Hands Down Handicap Hurdle
OwnerName: The Les & Jan Gilbert Racing Legacy
Spotlight: 0-14 over hurdles in Ireland but ran well in some big fields last year; campaigned mainly at about 3m but interesting to see what Chris Gordon can do with him; changed hands for £9,500; market could be informative.

RaceName: Blackmore Proudly Sponsoring Brighton Racecourse Handicap
Spotlight: Ran well for second over C&D on his seasonal return in June and went one better at Sandown (1m, good to firm) 31 days ago; found little off the bridle when well beaten at Salisbury on Friday; would have a point to prove if turned out quickly.

RaceName: Blackmore Proudly Sponsoring Brighton Racecourse Handicap
Spotlight: Should be well handicapped but his two runs for his current stable have resulted in heavy defeats; cheekpieces tried for a second time (well beaten on the occasion they were tried).

RaceName: Blackmore Proudly Sponsoring Brighton Racecourse Handicap
Spotlight: Beaten 12 times since his winning debut (for Karl Burke); went close at Chelmsford in March but two runs since have been underwhelming; tongue-tie now reached for.

RaceName: Blackmore Proudly Sponsoring Brighton Racecourse Handicap
Spotlight: Always prominent when winning a pair of handicaps at Windsor (1m, good to firm); came up short in his hat-trick bid at Lingfield (1m, AW) on Tuesday but Billy Loughnane replaces a 7lb claimer and there could still be further progress in him.

RaceName: Blackmore Proudly Sponsoring Brighton Racecourse Handicap
Spotlight: Prominent racer; won twice on AW earlier in the year and he has run some good races on turf this summer; latest C&D run was disappointing but he's the type to bounce back quickly.

RaceName: Hartes Group Apprentice Handicap
OwnerName: Martin W Walsh & Tony Carey & Brian Murray & Mark Hopkins
Spotlight: AW winner shaped nicely on seasonal reappearance at Leopardstown (1m2f, good) and stayed on nicely enough over 1m1f back there on latest; drops in grade and could go well upped in trip.

RaceName: Hartes Group Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Handicap debutante produced her best run when beaten a neck in a Sligo claimer; remote fourth in a Tramore maiden eight days ago; not obviously well treated and probably best watched.

RaceName: Hartes Group Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Won over 1m2f (gd-fm) at Newmarket for Tom Clover when wearing a visor and that returns here; needs to rebound from a heavy defeat at Galway but soft ground not ideal there; these conditions more suitable and yard going well now; chance.

RaceName: Hartes Group Apprentice Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs Helen Butler & John A Griffin & Mrs Bernadette Fahey
Spotlight: Won off 4lb lower last year; hinted at a return to form at Leopardstown on penultimate but jockey reported he stopped quickly back there on latest; may need a bit more help from the handicapper.

RaceName: Hartes Group Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Hasn't won since 2023 but the handicapper is relenting and he was only beaten 1l when fifth over 1m7f at Leopardstown last time; not beaten far over C&D in June off 4lb higher under this rider; in the mix.

RaceName: Hartes Group Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: AW winner in Britain posted a solid effort on Irish and stable debut at the Curragh in June but hasn't gone on from that; down the field over C&D on latest and same mark now; visor worn that day discarded; needs more.

RaceName: Hartes Group Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Losing run stretches back to 2023 and recent form over hurdles have not suggested a return to the winner's enclosure is imminent; can only be watched back on the Flat.

RaceName: Hartes Group Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Hasn't shown a whole lot in three maidens at 1m1f-1m5f; potential improver on handicap debut but his opening mark doesn't look overly generous.

RaceName: Hartes Group Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Two-time winner hasn't really fired this year but she did run on well from the back over 7f at Leopardstown last time so return to this longer trip a plus; soundly beaten in a division of this race last season off 11lb higher; others preferred.

RaceName: Hartes Group Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Is on a dangerous mark and it wasn't a bad effort on return from 419 days off at Bellewstown last month; should strip fitter now and has won twice at just short of this trip at Dundalk; not discounted.

RaceName: Hartes Group Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Won on seasonal return at Ballinrobe in May (9.5f, gd-yld); raised 7lb for that and has run well enough without really threatening to win in three starts since; probably in the handicapper's grip for now.

RaceName: Hartes Group Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Shed the maiden tag at the twelfth time of asking on latest at Fairyhouse (1m2f, good) under a well-judged ride; raised 6lb and moves up in grade so will need a career best to follow up.

RaceName: Hartes Group Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Won over hurdles and on the Flat (12.5f) at Limerick last year; ran well over timber at Sligo on his penultimate start in a claimer but heavy defeat back on the Flat at Tramore (2m) on latest; well handicapped but needs to rebound back in trip.

RaceName: Hartes Group Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Showed ability in three starts in Germany; bought for E55,000 at Arqana last month and makes handicap debut; market can reveal expectations on first run for Jessica Harrington.

RaceName: Hartes Group Apprentice Handicap
Spotlight: Showed little in maidens and similar story on handicap debut at Gowran on latest (9.5f, gd-fm) when beaten 17l; dropped 4lb but hard to make a case for.

RaceName: Hartes Group Apprentice Handicap
OwnerName: N J Hitchins & Mrs John M Weld
Spotlight: Getting the hang of things in handicaps and has gone close the last twice, including when beaten 0.5l over C&D early last month; same margin of defeat at Cork latest over 1m4f (gd-fm); nudged up another 4lb but big player again.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Supports Larsen's Pride Mares' Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Second to earlier-race contender Trouville before beaten a neck in a maiden at Newton Abbot, a race she would have won but for jumping out to the right and hitting the last hurdle; could be still be learning after only six races; probably on a fair mark for this first handicap.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Supports Larsen's Pride Mares' Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 2m5f novice winner in October; made handicap debut at Stratford last month (2m2f, good to firm) and ran as though that race was needed after a break of 252 days; better expected.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Supports Larsen's Pride Mares' Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Won a maiden hurdle in April 2025 and later runner-up in two handicaps; however, hard to warm to on this season's form.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Supports Larsen's Pride Mares' Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 9-1 when due to reappear from an absence here on Wednesday only to get loose before the start; 0-15 over hurdles and inconsistent in Ireland, but she ran the odd decent race there; not dismissed.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Supports Larsen's Pride Mares' Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Has lost her way since some initial promise and comfortably beaten in both her runs since moving yards; cheekpieces tried last time are removed.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Supports Larsen's Pride Mares' Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Lightly raced ex-Irish mare; no closer than 11l in four races in Britain, the latest her handicap debut over C&D (12-1).

RaceName: Neu-Servo Supports Larsen's Pride Mares' Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Hasn't had a lot of racing and was a close second over this trip at Uttoxeter in June despite market weakness; turn looks near.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Supports Larsen's Pride Mares' Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Fontwell winner last May (sole success; 2m3f, good) and two good runs this season, back there last time and at this venue the start before; solid chance.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Supports Larsen's Pride Mares' Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Dual AW winner; yet to win over hurdles but went close at Ffos Las in May (2m4f, good to soft; first-time cheekpieces); that run hasn't proved a springboard to anything better.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Supports Larsen's Pride Mares' Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Maiden on Flat and over hurdles (0-5); ran poorly on the Flat last time (second-time visor) but very effective in cheekpieces and she has the form to feature off this mark.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Supports Larsen's Pride Mares' Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: 0-12 under rules; poor final run for Fergal O'Brien and produced another when last to finish on yard debut at Stratford.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Supports Larsen's Pride Mares' Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Yet to win over hurdles but has three thirds to her name this year (2m1f-2m3f) and luck has deserted her in last two races, unseating early in March and then tack issues a factor in May; may prefer softer ground but one to consider.

RaceName: Neu-Servo Supports Larsen's Pride Mares' Handicap Hurdle
Spotlight: Only 1-19 over hurdles and last four runs were forgettable; however, she's back from a break with Sean Bowen riding off a feather weight.

RaceName: TRM BIOACTIVE Energy Boost Handicap
Spotlight: Two wins last year and ran a fine race when a close fourth in the Listed Galtres Stakes at York (1m4f, gd-fm); pleasing comeback run at Sligo 18 days ago and sharper now; player off the same mark.

RaceName: TRM BIOACTIVE Energy Boost Handicap
OwnerName: Westerberg & Mrs Magnier & M Tabor & D Smith
Spotlight: Decent form last year included a Group 3 placing behind Derby winner Christmas Day; form has gone the wrong way so far this year, though it wasn't a terrible run at Galway on latest (1m4f, yld-sft); eased 1lb for that 5.25l defeat; needs more back in trip.

RaceName: TRM BIOACTIVE Energy Boost Handicap
OwnerName: Bronsan Racing & H Redknapp & John Breslin
Spotlight: Two wins this season, over 1m2f at Leopardstown in May off 77 and on latest when swooping late to score by a head over C&D off 79; a 3lb rise for that seems reasonable and likely to give another good account.

RaceName: TRM BIOACTIVE Energy Boost Handicap
Spotlight: Last win came over C&D just over a year ago off 4lb lower; starting to come into form now, solid fifth at the Curragh in June (1m2f, gd-fm) and then beaten just 0.75l at Leopardstown (1m5f, good) last time; this shorter trip fine and she's a contender.

RaceName: TRM BIOACTIVE Energy Boost Handicap
Spotlight: Two wins on heavy ground, a Tipperary maiden and a conditions race at Gowran last September; yet to win a handicap and out of sorts on last two runs at Gowran; coming down the weights but others arrive in better form.

RaceName: TRM BIOACTIVE Energy Boost Handicap
Spotlight: Five runs for Ger Lyons included three placings on the AW and a 6l win in a fillies' maiden at Fairyhouse (1m2f, good, runner up won a maiden by 5l next start); since bought for 210,000gns and has joined Denis Hogan; could be on a nice mark for her handicap debut and worth checking in the market.

RaceName: TRM BIOACTIVE Energy Boost Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark on hurdling debut at Limerick last month and followed up with a first Flat win at Galway (9.5f, yielding), showing a willing attitude to score by a neck; 4lb rise more than negated by rider's 7lb claim but has to prove stamina for this longer trip (bred to stay but well beaten both previous starts at 1m2f-1m4f).

RaceName: TRM BIOACTIVE Energy Boost Handicap
Spotlight: Three-time AW winner is 0-22 on turf but has placed on multiple occasions; not beaten far on last turf start at Leopardstown last month (1m, good) and kept on steadily for a 3.5l sixth of 14 over 10.5f at Dundalk latest; eased another 1lb and becoming well handicapped; chance.

RaceName: TRM BIOACTIVE Energy Boost Handicap
Spotlight: Four-time winner, most recently over C&D (yielding) last October; yet to hit top form this term and only midfield on latest at Galway; best form on much softer ground than this and 8lb wrong here.
